Game Overview

Castle Protectors puts players into a shooter experience centered on defend King Pyrus's realm in Castle Protectors, a challenging strategy game where you, the mighty Bruse, must thwart Monster King Lagruse's onslaught. Strategically deploy defenders, upgrade your arsenal, and outwit ever-stronger foes to safeguard the castle and earn your title as the ultimate protector. Can you hold the line?
